zh.title: 服務
zh.lead: 為老師提供專業支援，結合科學實證方法與實踐工具，幫助他們更好地理解和回應有特殊學習需要的學生，讓每個孩子發掘潛能。

challenge.h: 許多孩子正面對困難，而老師需要支援
challenge.lead: 今日的學生面對愈來愈多情緒、社交及學習上的挑戰。老師有心幫忙，卻往往欠缺合適的工具、策略和信心，難以帶來長遠的改變。
challenge.belief: 我們相信，每個孩子都值得被理解。

steps.h: 從角色體驗與合作搭建，讓抽象概念變成親身體驗
steps.highlight: 培訓特色｜由引導師帶領同事間的反思與交流
steps.tagline: 從腦科學出發的心理健康覺察之旅

items.p: 設身處地，從學生或同事的角度感受一個情景。
與同事合作搭建大腦模型，把抽象的腦科學概念變成看得見、摸得到的東西。
抽出事件卡，一起走進真實課室裡可能發生的時刻。
練習具體的支持說話，再與引導師一起反思哪些回應最有幫助。

tic.p: 一種先問「發生了什麼事」而不是「你有什麼問題」的取向。它讓學校成為令學生和教職員都感到安全的地方。

list.p: 學生和教職員在身體和情緒上都感到安全。
清楚、一致地說明將會發生什麼，以及原因。
同事彼此學習，互相支持。
決定是共同作出的，而不是單方面施加。
學生的聲音被聽見，也有真正的選擇。
尊重每個孩子的背景與身份。

cos.p: 「安全圓圈」框架已融入遊戲設計及引導師培訓。

list.p: 孩子知道有可信任的成人在身邊，就更敢去探索。
當孩子感到不安，可以回到成人身邊得到安慰。

cta.h: 投資老師，改變學生人生！
cta.p: 提供培訓日期與教師人數，商議到校安排。

en.title: Service
en.lead: We give teachers professional support, combining evidence-based methods with practical tools, to better understand and respond to students with special learning needs, so every child can discover their potential.

challenge.h: Many children are struggling, and teachers need support
challenge.lead: Today’s students face growing emotional, social and learning challenges. Teachers want to help, but often lack the right tools, strategies and confidence to make a lasting difference.
challenge.belief: We believe every child deserves to be understood.

steps.h: From role experience and collaborative building, abstract concepts become lived experience
steps.highlight: Training highlight | Facilitator-guided reflection and application among colleagues
steps.tagline: Mental health journey starting with brain science

items.p: Step into a student’s or colleague’s shoes and feel a situation from the inside.
Build a brain model together, so abstract brain science becomes something you can see and touch.
Draw an event card and walk through a moment that could really happen in a classroom.
Practise supportive things to say, then reflect with the facilitator on which responses help most.

tic.p: An approach that asks “what happened to you?” before “what is wrong with you?”. It helps a school feel safe for students and staff alike.

list.p: Students and staff feel physically and emotionally safe.
Be clear and consistent about what will happen and why.
Colleagues learn from and support each other.
Students are heard and have real choices.
Respect each child’s background and identity.

cos.p: The Circle of Security framework has been integrated into both the game design and facilitator training.

list.p: Children explore more confidently when they know a trusted adult is there.
When a child feels upset, they can return to an adult for comfort.

cta.h: Invest in teachers to change students’ lives!
cta.p: Send us your preferred date and number of teachers to discuss on-site arrangements.
